ashokapillar.name: Ashoka Pillar
ashokapillar.desc: If this card is Summoned: You can add 1 Equip Spell from your Deck to your hand, then if this card is in Attack Position, change it to Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Ashoka Pillar" once per turn. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: Take 2000 damage.

battleoftheelements.name: Battle of the Elements
battleoftheelements.desc: Activate only while all monsters on the field are face-up. Both players send monsters they control to the Graveyard so that they each control only 1 Attribute.

coachsoldierwolfbark.name: Coach Soldier Wolfbark
coachsoldierwolfbark.desc: You can target 1 Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position. Its effects are negated. You can only use the effect of "Coach Soldier Wolfbark" once per turn.

ddpatrolplane.name: D.D. Patrol Plane
ddpatrolplane.desc: During the End Phase, if this card is currently banished, and was banished this turn: You can banish 1 card from your hand, field, or GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card in Attack Position. You can only use this effect of "D.D. Patrol Plane" once per turn.

dragunityguisarme.name: Dragunity Guisarme
dragunityguisarme.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower WIND Dragon or Winged Beast monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but negate its effects. If this card is currently equipped to a monster: You can Special Summon this equipped card. You can only use each effect of "Dragunity Guisarme" once per turn.

endymionslab.name: Endymion's Lab
endymionslab.desc: This card's name becomes "Magical Citadel of Endymion" while in the Spell & Trap Zone. Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell resolves. Once per turn, after damage calculation, if your Spellcaster monster is destroyed by battle: You can remove 6 Spell Counters from your field; Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Spellcaster monster from your hand or Deck. You can only activate 1 "Endymion's Lab" per turn.

futuresamurai.name: Future Samurai
futuresamurai.desc:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
● Once per turn: You can banish 1 monster from your Graveyard to target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy that target.

gardenoftalistones.name: Garden of Talistones
gardenoftalistones.desc: While you control 5 cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, any battle damage a player takes is halved, also once per turn, you can activate 1 Continuous Trap Card the turn it was Set. During the Standby Phase: You can reveal 5 Continuous Traps from your Deck with different names, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to Set, and shuffle the rest into the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Garden of Talistones" once per turn.

ghosttoken.name: Ghost Token
ghosttoken.desc: Special Summoned with the effect of "Damage Translation".

goldpridebetterlucknexttime.name: Gold Pride - Better Luck Next Time!
goldpridebetterlucknexttime.desc: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Gold Pride" monster from your Deck to your hand, and if you do, lose LP equal to its ATK. If a face-up "Gold Pride" monster(s) you control that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck returns to the Extra Deck (except during the Damage Step): You can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Gold Pride - Better Luck Next Time!" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Gold Pride - Better Luck Next Time!" per turn.

imprudentintrusion.name: Imprudent Intrusion
imprudentintrusion.desc:
Your LP must be lower than your opponent's to activate and to resolve this effect.
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to the difference in LP.
● Special Summon 1 monster from your GY with ATK less than or equal to the difference in LP.

kingofyamimakai.name: King of Yamimakai
kingofyamimakai.desc: Wields the power of darkness to destroy its enemies.

majespecterunicornkirin.name: Majespecter Unicorn - Kirin
majespecterunicornkirin.desc: During either player's turn: You can target 1 Pendulum Monster in your Monster Zone and 1 monster your opponent controls; return them to the hand(s). You can only use this effect of "Majespecter Unicorn - Kirin" once per turn. Cannot be targeted or destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

megazowler.name: Megazowler
megazowler.desc: Nothing stands in the way of this spike-covered dinosaur!

mormolith.name: Mormolith
mormolith.desc: You can Tribute 1 face-up EARTH monster to destroy all face-up monsters with DEF equal to or less than the ATK of the Tributed card.

number51finisherthestrongarm.name: Number 51: Finisher the Strong Arm
number51finisherthestrongarm.desc:
3 Level 3 monsters
Cannot be destroyed by battle. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; place 1 Counter on this card (max. 3). At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled, and has 3 of these Counters: You can destroy all cards your opponent controls.

onomatopickup.name: Onomatopickup
onomatopickup.desc: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Onomat" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Onomatopickup". You can target 1 "Zubaba", "Gagaga", "Gogogo", or "Dododo" monster you control; all monsters you currently control become that monster's Level until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field). You can only use this effect of "Onomatopickup" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Onomatopickup" per turn.

ordealofatraveler.name: Ordeal of a Traveler
ordealofatraveler.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Your opponent chooses 1 random card in your hand and calls the type of the card (Monster, Spell, or Trap), and if they call it wrong, return the attacking monster to the hand.

painfuldecision.name: Painful Decision
painfuldecision.desc: Send 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, add 1 card with the same name as that card from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Painful Decision" per turn.

phantombeastwildhorn.name: Phantom Beast Wild-Horn
phantombeastwildhorn.desc: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

ritualbeastambush.name: Ritual Beast Ambush
ritualbeastambush.desc: Target 1 of your "Ritual Beast Tamer" monsters and 1 of your "Spiritual Beast" monsters that are banished and/or in your Graveyard; Special Summon them in Defense Position. After this card is activated, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except "Ritual Beast" monsters, for the rest of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Ritual Beast Ambush" per turn.

shadowghoulofthelabyrinth.name: Shadow Ghoul of the Labyrinth
shadowghoulofthelabyrinth.desc: You can discard this card; add 1 "Labyrinth Wall" card from your Deck to your hand. At the start of the Damage Step, if your opponent's monster battles, while you control a "Labyrinth Wall" card: You can banish this card from your GY; destroy that opponent's monster. You can only use each effect of "Shadow Ghoul of the Labyrinth" once per turn.

slipsummon.name: Slip Summon
slipsummon.desc: Activate only when your opponent Summons a monster. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand in face-up Defense Position. Return it to the owner's hand during the End Phase.

speedroidwingsynchron.name: Speedroid Wing Synchron
speedroidwingsynchron.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
Once per turn: You can destroy this card and 1 Level 2 WIND Pendulum Monster Card in your Pendulum Zone, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Clear Wing Synchro Dragon" from your Extra Deck (this is treated as a Synchro Summon), also for the rest of this turn, cards in your Pendulum Zones cannot be destroyed by card effects, and you cannot Special Summon, except WIND monsters.

[ Monster Effect ] 
If this card is added to your Extra Deck face-up, and you control 2 or more different Types of WIND Synchro Monsters: You can send 1 "Speedroid" Spell/Trap from your Deck to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Speedroid Wing Synchron" once per turn.

starsalignabovetheshrine.name: Stars Align Above the Shrine

sunlitsentinel.name: Sunlit Sentinel
sunlitsentinel.desc: You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of the next turn after this Set card was destroyed and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card, then destroy all cards your opponent controls in this card's column.

superantikaijuwarmachinemechathunderking.name: Super Anti-Kaiju War Machine Mecha-Thunder-King
superantikaijuwarmachinemechathunderking.desc: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; banish 1 "Kaiju" monster you control that is owned by your opponent, then, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your GY. You can only control 1 "Kaiju" monster. This card is unaffected by other "Kaiju" cards' effects, also it cannot be destroyed by battle with a "Kaiju" monster. During your End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Super Anti-Kaiju War Machine Mecha-Thunder-King" once per Duel.

superheavysamuraisoulshieldwall.name: Superheavy Samurai Soulshield Wall
superheavysamuraisoulshieldwall.desc: You can target 1 "Superheavy Samurai" monster you control; equip this monster from your hand or your side of the field to that target. It gains 1200 DEF. When the monster equipped with this card by this effect is targeted for an attack: You can send this Equip Card to the Graveyard; negate that attack, but the equipped monster's DEF becomes 0.

theiatheprimalbeing.name: Theia, the Primal Being
theiatheprimalbeing.desc: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 11 or more; Special Summon this card from your hand, then if you control no other monsters, you can destroy 1 monster on the field with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied). You can only use this effect of "Theia, the Primal Being" once per turn. Neither player can Normal and/or Special Summon more than 4 times per turn while this card is face-up in the Monster Zone.

toonpageflip.name: Toon Page-Flip
toonpageflip.desc: If you control "Toon World": Reveal 3 Toon monsters with different names from your Deck, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to Special Summon, ignoring its Summoning conditions, also shuffle the rest into your Deck. You can only activate 1 "Toon Page-Flip" per turn.

tribrigadeshuraigtheominousomen.name: Tri-Brigade Shuraig the Ominous Omen
tribrigadeshuraigtheominousomen.desc:
2+ Beast, Beast-Warrior, and/or Winged Beast monsters
If this card is Special Summoned, or if another Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field: You can banish 1 card on the field. If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster from your Deck to your hand, whose Level is less than or equal to the number of your banished Beast, Beast-Warrior, and Winged Beast monsters. You can only use each effect of "Tri-Brigade Shuraig the Ominous Omen" once per turn.

wakecupearl.name: WAKE CUP! Earl
wakecupearl.desc:
FLIP: You can send face-up cards your opponent controls to the GY, up to the number of Flip monsters you control.
If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 other Flip monster, and if you do, Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position. During your End Phase: You can target 1 Flip monster in your GY; Special Summon it in face-down Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "WAKE CUP! Earl" once per turn.

whitedolphin.name: White Dolphin
whitedolphin.desc: ''A white dolphin with a horn that summons huge tidal waves.''
